_doc: Action-type -> tier map for Medic's dial-4 reversibility gate. The Medic operator (agents/medic/CLAUDE.md) classifies each owned alert into an action_type (e.g. restart-daemon, retrigger-watcher, redispatch-chain-leg, rotate-credential, edit-config). The tier here decides what Medic does: 'reversible' -> PR2 will act + notify; 'privileged' -> PR2/PR3 will emit append_approval_request whose payload IS the command (Larry replies 'go' and the existing approval gate runs it); 'judgment' -> escalate diagnose-only. PR1 ships this map as DATA only; the act-branch that consumes it is stubbed -- every owned alert results in an escalation. Loader is fail safe: missing or malformed file is treated as empty; unknown action_types resolve to 'judgment' (the safest default).
